answer: In an iterative web-of-trust protocol, each agent registers as a graph vertex and stakes collateral within a time-locked vault. Trust is established incrementally by layering endorsement signatures like a cultured pearl, forcing an adversary to incur the verifiable cost of forfeited capital and sustained honest interaction per identity. A key limitation is that this gradual onboarding introduces high latency and disproportionately restricts capital-poor agents from participating.
